## Part 1 — what this take brings: behaviour changes for every document

The rule all five meet: architecture · `decision/upstream-behaviour-changes-ratified-per-take` — «An upstream behaviour
change for every document is taken only ratified for its take». Read against the playbook's escalate patterns
(`rul-izni57qv` boundary widening, `rul-72xhfjoz` boundary widening by upstream merge): none of the five adds a
carrier, an exit, a content class, a listener, an env read, a log site or a field — the phase reads none as a

all the same, which `rul-3ndrhilc` names a call the founder owns. Each «take» is M1's tree; each «undo» reverts that
commit's non-test hunks in the merged tree and drops its test, neither measured apart.

- **Our rules it meets:** security §Untrusted input (page scripts; the precedent of `URLSearchParams` recorded as «a

  browser runs JavaScript only behind its non-default `javascript` feature (`decision/javascript-opt-in`).
- **Escher routes input through it:** no — no driver carrier reaches script; the stand runs no page script. No example
  page of ours calls `replace` (`git grep classList`: `toggle` alone).

  edit to `interfaces.js` meets the undo at each merge).
- **Depends on:** none.

### E2 — `c4328ad5b` «Resolve float keyword sizes and logical float/clear sides (#1690)» — layout, every document
- **What changes:** `float: inline-start | inline-end` and `clear: inline-start | inline-end` resolve to the containing
